title: LIT, 1m protected-swing stop, 1 NQ mini on every trade
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: Risk is small (~$270-310) but the tight stop's edge is gone in H2 and 2021-25. 2026 H1 (pick) n=80 3.12/wk win 12.5% PF 2.95 net +22,578 ($3,704/mo) DD -3,324 median stop 14.375 pts, 10.0 micros, $268 at risk; eval 2wk 26.6/7.0 1mo 39.8/33.6 pass rate 46.4% median 7.0; 2026 H2 (check) n=40 2.56/wk win 10.0% PF 1.32 net +2,199 ($592/mo) DD -4,484 median stop 17.125 pts, 10.0 micros, $309 at risk; eval 2wk 11.5/6.4 1mo 24.4/24.4 pass rate 65.5% median 19.5; 2021-25 reference only n=510 2.38/wk win 8.2% PF 0.83 net -17,069 ($-334/mo) DD -21,159 median stop 17.25 pts, 10.0 micros, $320 at risk; eval 2wk 7.6/6.2 1mo 11.0/34.2 pass rate 17.7% median 12.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
